governanceTimelockHardening.notes: TARGET only. Spencer delegated the executor choice to Pete. minDelayTarget 86400 (24h) is the mainnet-ready delay; 300s is the live getMinDelay() and is too weak for mainnet. 24h is a common protocol-change delay and still lets the Safe cancel inside the window. The named executor is the governance Safe 0x12b3683A30De9845767c1f27a5D23591cA83dD54, which already holds PROPOSER_ROLE and CANCELLER_ROLE. The batch grants EXECUTOR_ROLE to that Safe, revokes EXECUTOR_ROLE from address(0), and calls updateDelay(86400). The schedule delay stays the live 300 seconds until the batch executes. Live chain stays 300/open until that Safe applies docs/runbooks/GOVERNANCE_TIMELOCK_HARDENING.md. This object does not mean the chain already has a 24h delay. Agents do not --broadcast.
